name: Rerir
desc: One of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, also known as "Rächer of Solnari."

imgDesc.text: Rerir before using the Abyssal powers.

customize.text:
<color=#ffd780>October 25, 2025</color>
"Sin" has tainted the past, and "Fate" rules the future, but his story has yet to reach its end. Rerir's obsession shakes the laws of the world — such is the power of a Sinner. — "The Visionary" Vedrfolnir

<color=#ffd780>November 7, 2025</color>
Greetings, Travelers! The latest emojis from Genshin Impact are now available on HoYoLAB~
Paimon's Paintings include a collection of chibi emojis of various Genshin Impact characters. We hope you like them! Paimon will continue to paint more cute emojis for everyone~

Rerir was a secret agent in the service of King Irmin, who chased down the descendants of the Crimson Moon.
Tholindis
Rerir's fiancée and a descendant of the Crimson Moon. Knowing they couldn't be together, Tholindis stepped through the Crimson Moon's Moon Gate.
Five Sinners
Although Rerir had no personal ambitions, he succumbed to the call of the Abyss to save his beloved. Along with four other prominent figures of Khaenri'ah, he gained the power to destroy the entire world. He became a Sinner, a transcendent being with a world-shattering power.

customize.name: Moon Goddesses
customize.desc: Aria, Sonnet, and Canon — three sisters and Moon Goddesses who once ruled the firmament. Columbina Hyposelenia is a Moon Goddess who was born thousands of years after the Three Moon's death.

customize.text:
To retrieve Tholindis from the space beyond the Moon Gate, he stepped after her. Inside this space, an unknown force tore him apart, and only thanks to the power of the Abyss did he survive.
The Wild Hunt
Rerir's body was once torn into countless pieces and hurled into the swirling chaos of time itself. But even so, his life and will were not extinguished. His remains became the reason for The Wild Hunt's attacks. To become stronger and get his body back, Rerir tries to find all his remains.

customize.name: Il Dottore
customize.desc: The Second of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, codenamed The Doctor. Had multiple "segments" of himself, nearly all of which he destroyed in a deal with the Dendro Archon. His real name is Zandik.

customize.text: The Fatui Harbinger collected numerous fragments of Rerir's body to resurrect him when he needed him. Dottore exploited Rächer of Solnari's hatred for the Moons for his own purposes.

customize.name: Flins
customize.desc: A Lightkeeper of Nod-Krai, guardian of a lighthouse and graveyard on a northern isle. An enigmatic gentleman, cultured and courtly.

customize.text:
One day, Flins discovered strange crystals and placed them into his lantern. It turned out that these crystals were Rerir's heart, so the Sinner began to hunt them. Thanks to the help of the Traveler, the heart was cleansed of the power of the Abyss and destroyed.
In addition, Rerir took on the form of Flins to kill the Lightkeepers' Sergeant Major Sousi.

customize.name: Twin
customize.desc: The Traveler's twin, Princess/Prince of Khaenri'ah, Savior, and the Princess/Prince of the Abyss Order.

customize.text: Rerir took the form of the Traveler's twin to trick them into stealing the Moon Marrow, the remains of the Eternal Moon.

customize.name: Kuuvahki
customize.desc: Kuuvahki is a type of native Nod-Krai magnetism-like energy, polarized not by positive and negative, but by red and blue.

customize.text: The power of the kuuvahki is the opposite of the power of the Abyss, and when they meet, the stronger one suppresses the weaker one. Rerir was able to absorb the kuuvahki from the earth and the cannon designed to destroy The Wild Hunt to become stronger and gain a body.

customize.name: Columbina
customize.desc: The Trilune Goddess and the former Third of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, known as Damselette. Her real name is Columbina Hyposelenia.

customize.text: Rerir wanted to destroy the Moon Goddess, whose power was associated with the Frost Moon.
